name: ai-command
description: A Cmd+K command palette with an AI mode: type to search pages and actions, or press Tab to ask your workspace — the answer streams into the fixed-height panel with numbered citations that highlight their source chips, and suggests next steps you can run right there (create a Linear issue, open a Notion doc) with running, done and retry states. Gliding highlight, combobox/listbox semantics, polite live region, reduced-motion fallbacks and a self-playing walkthrough that stops at first real interaction.
